nodes.label: moklet.org Platform
nodes.rationale: SMK Telkom Malang integrated school portal consolidating bulletin boards, Google Forms, paper aspirations, WhatsApp announcements into one system with structured governance workflows

nodes.label: Aspiration System
nodes.rationale: Anonymous or named student submissions to school units or orgs, rate-limited via Upstash Redis, triggers WhatsApp via Fonnte

nodes.label: Organization Management
nodes.rationale: Multi-period org structure with hierarchy levels, custom roles, drag-and-drop organogram, real-time member assignment via email

nodes.label: CMS News System
nodes.rationale: Replaces physical school bulletin board with rich Markdown editor, Cloudinary thumbnails, ISR-based publication, tags and OG metadata

nodes.label: Dynamic Form Builder
nodes.rationale: Internal Google Forms alternative with 8 field types, Excel export, ECharts analytics, rate-limited submissions

nodes.label: Serverless Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Free tier serverless stack: Vercel Edge + Serverless Functions, Supabase PostgreSQL with Supavisor pooling, Upstash Redis for caching and rate limiting

nodes.label: ISR Rendering
nodes.rationale: Incremental Static Regeneration with 60s revalidation for public pages, 900s for admin pages

nodes.label: Recruitment Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multi-step campaign with ANNOUNCEMENT and FORM step types, applicant tracking, per-step evaluation, auto-creates Org_Member on acceptance. Current leaders recruit for next period's org, making historical periods immutable.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Authorization
nodes.rationale: SuperAdmin/Admin short-circuit → isOrgLeader check → granular Org_Permission check. Consistent across all 6 capability helpers.

nodes.label: Period-Based Governance
nodes.rationale: Governance periods (e.g. 2024-2025) with exactly one active. Current leadership manages next period's recruitment; past periods immutable.

nodes.label: Code Review Security Findings
nodes.rationale: 4 CRITICAL, 2 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 2 LOW findings including campaign validation, timezone handling, step order races, file injection

nodes.label: NextAuth Authentication
nodes.rationale: JWT session, Google OAuth (domain-gated @smktelkom-mlg.sch.id) + Credentials, middleware protects /admin/*

nodes.label: GEP Agent Skills System
nodes.rationale: Gene Evolution Protocol skills: innovate, repair, optimize — each with preconditions, constraints, blast radius estimation, and EvolutionEvent recording

nodes.label: TypeScript Build Errors
nodes.rationale: Compilation errors in event committee components, missing exports, implicit any types, missing module declarations
